title: Blur
studio_context: Mayfair, London, and Reykjavik, from June 1996: the band jamming, Stephen Street cutting loops from the jams; Song 2's drums two kits on the room mics, looped.

drum_performances.name: Dave Rowntree
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The turn to American lo-fi: Song 2's drums, his and Coxon's on two kits, cut into a loop; Beetlebum's plain eighths and ride.

evidence.note: Coxon plays additional drums on Song 2 and Strange News from Another Star; the rest is Rowntree.
